_comment: The catalogue of things in the world you can act on. This file says what a kind of object *is* — its verb, its price and what it does. Where the instances stand is world data: `data/world/overworld.json` carries an `interactables` list of { x, y, type, label? } records, which the Tiled round trip turns into a draggable object layer (see docs/MAP-EDITING.md). So the house agent places them and the designer retypes them, and neither needs code. `cost_key` names a config key rather than a literal so a trinket can bend the price; `effect` is one entry of the same effect vocabulary hooks use, applied by Game.apply_effects. A `critter` names a species in data/content/critters.json: the placement spawns that animal where it stands, reach follows it as it walks, and `critter_event` is fired at it when you act — which is how one Pet verb makes the dog follow you and the cat leave.

interactables.name: The front door
interactables.desc: Shut, and it means it. Outside is a purchase.

effect.text: The lock turns. The morning is out there.

interactables.name: The stove
interactables.desc: Three hours of moving quicker, and then the bill.

interactables.name: The kitchen counter
interactables.desc: Four hours of getting more out of everything you do.

interactables.name: The dog
interactables.desc: He has been waiting since before you woke up.

effect.text: He leans his whole weight into your hand. Nothing is wrong anywhere.

interactables.name: The cat
interactables.desc: Available, conditionally.

effect.text: Two strokes, and then a look that says that was the two.

interactables.name: Spite
interactables.desc: He has been waiting. He is always going to have been waiting.

interactables.name: The barricade
interactables.verb: Ask them to let you through
interactables.desc: Leaves, pine needles and boxes, and children behind it who are entirely serious.

interactables.name: Bird
interactables.desc: She is counting something in a jar and will not say what until she is finished.

interactables.name: Mrs Ollard
interactables.desc: She was at the window a moment ago and is now, somehow, out here.

interactables.name: Bram
interactables.desc: He is carrying more than he can have needed, and none of it is his.

interactables.name: Tobin
interactables.desc: Behind the bar, wiping something that is already clean.

interactables.name: Cobb
interactables.desc: He sleeps in the back and it shows.

interactables.name: The mill door
interactables.desc: Warm flour dust, and the floor humming under it.

effect.text: Inside it is all one working room, and the whole floor is humming.

interactables.name: The commonhouse door
interactables.desc: Wax, cold stone, and a room built for more people than are in it.

effect.text: The screens passage first, then the hall, and every chair in it is empty.

interactables.name: The Wayhouse door
interactables.desc: Beer, woodsmoke, and one room to let above the tap.

effect.text: Somebody has been in the taproom this morning and pushed the chair back.

interactables.name: The Ollards' door
interactables.desc: The chair by the window is still warm.

effect.text: The chair at the window is angled at the square. Of course it is.

interactables.name: Cobb's door
interactables.desc: Sacking, tallow, and whatever he has not sold this month.

effect.text: The counter runs the width of the light, and the back room smells of Cobb.

interactables.name: The Blind Ewe
interactables.desc: Ale, hearth-smoke, and a floor that has been swept once this week.

effect.text: The fire is in and the snug is cold. It was a yard once; you can tell.

interactables.name: Tobin's door
interactables.desc: A house belonging to a man who works twenty feet away.

effect.text: One room to cook in, one to sleep in, and nothing at all on the walls.

interactables.name: The tinker's door
interactables.desc: Hot metal, oil, and two benches in the middle of the light.

effect.text: The forge is banked. Both benches are covered and neither is tidy.

interactables.name: The mayor's door
interactables.desc: Polish, paper, and a house that expects to be looked at.

effect.text: You are received in the parlour. The study door is the one that stays shut.

interactables.name: The empty house
interactables.desc: Nobody has lived here since the winter, and the door still opens.

effect.text: One chair in the middle of the floor, facing nothing. Bram keeps the key.

interactables.name: The farmhouse door
interactables.desc: Bread, milk and mud, in that order.

effect.text: The range is lit and the long table is laid for more than are coming.

interactables.name: The west door
interactables.desc: Your neighbour's, and the door is never locked.

effect.text: One room, one bed, one fire. It is the same house as yours, made smaller.

interactables.name: The east door
interactables.desc: Your other neighbour's, and the washing is still out.

effect.text: One room, one bed, one fire, and the kettle is on the wrong side.

interactables.name: The shut house
interactables.desc: Bolted from the inside, and nobody has answered it since the winter.

effect.text: Bolted from the inside. Whoever did that is still in there, or was when they did it.
